detail.title: M200 Vertical Ergonomic Wireless Mouse - Black
detail.overview: The Ant M200 is a vertical 'handshake-grip' wireless mouse designed to keep the wrist and forearm in a more natural position, reducing strain during long work or gaming sessions. Five adjustable DPI settings (800/1200/1600/2400/4000) let you match sensitivity to any screen size or task, from detailed editing to fast navigation. Silent clicks on the left and right buttons keep it office-friendly, while stable 2.4GHz wireless connectivity offers true plug-and-play performance with the included USB receiver — no drivers needed. Its rechargeable battery and tunnel-shaped optical sensor round out a comfortable, dependable everyday mouse for laptop or PC use.
